LG Energy Solution.why: battery maker whose ESS business supplies LFP battery energy storage to data centers; it expects ESS demand from big tech and AI companies' power needs, and its BESS is qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready for AI factories
LG Energy Solution.evidence: The ESS market is expected to grow steadily on the spread of renewables and the power demand of big tech and AI companies; the company has entered ESS system integration, building large ESS sites itself (LG Energy Solution half-year report, DART 08-13-2026)

players.product: LFP battery energy storage systems (BESS) for AI data centers -- 2.5 MW / 5.1 MWh AC battery blocks (NVIDIA DSX Ready BESS), ESS cells and system integration

quarterly_data.quarter: LG Energy Solution press release: LG Energy Solution's Battery Energy Storage System (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LG Energy Solution's Battery Energy Storage System qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready BESS -- a qualification program for partner products meeting applicable NVIDIA DSX reference design requirements for AI factories; the BESS meets the requirements for AC energy storage solutions, helping customers accelerate time-to-power and handle AI load smoothing, voltage ride-through and power reliability. The qualified product uses modular 2.5 MW / 5.1 MWh battery blocks and an integrated AC solution with grid-forming capability. In North America the company has a localized value chain (cell manufacturing, pack production, system integration) and plans to secure more than 50 GWh of LFP battery cell production capacity across five regional production facilities by the end of 2026, meeting demand from data centers, infrastructure developments and utility-scale storage. Chang Beom Kang, Head of ESS Battery Division: being selected as a partner for NVIDIA's first-ever DSX Ready program validates its BESS products, and the company will expand its digital infrastructure business.
quarterly_data.figure: 2.5 MW / 5.1 MWh BESS blocks; more than 50 GWh of North American LFP cell capacity planned by end-2026
